_comment: Issue #77: the settings + accessibility surface, canonical end-to-end. No fixture needed -- boots straight at title (starts_at_title) so the FIRST phase covers the boot path (settings.cfg loaded before title, the bus-routing fix live from process start) via Settings opened from the TITLE screen; the SECOND phase re-opens it from the in-game PAUSE menu after a real New Game, proving the SAME panel/state survives the title->world boundary and a later save/load round-trip. Covers: (1) the CONFIRMED bus-routing bug fix -- AudioServer.get_bus_send('UI') == 'SFX' (a real bus-GRAPH assertion, not by ear), SFX untouched (still sends to Master); (2) a real SFX volume slider move asserted via AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db (linear_to_db formula, headless-real since wi_audio.gd's bus setup is no longer headless-gated); (3) fullscreen toggle via its ui_settings_rendered payload; (4) a text-scale step change (100%->115%) immediately followed by a real interact-at-spawn (facing RIGHT from the classless-start default (2,3), (3,3) is open floor -- INTERACT_NOTHING) proving the TOAST panel (a copy-fit-budgeted surface) still renders cleanly post-scale; (5) reduce_motion toggled, then proven to SURVIVE a full Save->Load round-trip (which tears down and rebuilds EVERY UI layer, including this panel itself, via game_loaded's swap_to_world) by reading the live WISettings autoload directly, not the save file; (6) the Controls reference sub-page renders; (7) Replay Hints fires its confirmation + toast, re-arming the two one-shot session hints WITHOUT touching any accomplishment counter (see wi_settings.gd's replay_hints() doc comment); (8) settings.cfg exists on disk both immediately at boot (WIAudio's own unconditional first-save) and again at the very end. Every control exercised through BOTH a keyboard path (move+confirm) and a mouse path (click_title_row/click_pause_row/click_settings_row) somewhere in the run, per the issue #84 standard.

steps._comment: == BOOT-PATH PROOF (before any player action): the bus graph fix is live from process start, and settings.cfg already exists (WIAudio's own _load_settings->set_bus_volume chain writes it unconditionally at _ready()).
== TITLE -> Settings (MOUSE path): row 5 = 'Settings' (ROWS appended at the end, never inserted earlier).

assert_event_logged (whole-log scan), not wait_for_event: this exact all-defaults snapshot already fired as part of open() itself (BEFORE ui_settings_shown, by construction -- see settings_panel.gd's open() doc comment), so it's already behind the forward-only wait cursor by the time ui_settings_shown resolves; nothing LATER reproduces all-defaults once the very next steps start changing values.
== SFX slider (KEYBOARD path): cursor starts at 'Master volume' (index 0) on a fresh open() -- down x2 reaches 'SFX volume' (index 2).
== Fullscreen toggle: down x1 -> 'Fullscreen' (index 3), Confirm flips it.
== Text Scale step: down x1 -> 'Text Scale' (index 4), Confirm cycles 100%->115% (step 0->1).
== New Game (MOUSE path): row 1 = 'New Game'. Classless-start default spawn (2,3), facing RIGHT -- lands on the open (3,3) cell.

== COPY-FIT PROOF at the scaled font: an interact into open ground -> INTERACT_NOTHING -> the TOAST panel (a budgeted surface, TOAST_FIELDS' own family) renders cleanly through message_layer.gd's LIVE theme-font wrap math -- no hang, no truncation garbage, exact text.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: == In-game PAUSE -> Settings (MOUSE path): row 8 = 'Settings' (index 7, appended after 'Quit to Title'). The panel is a FRESH instance (world swap rebuilt every UI layer) -- its render still reflects fullscreen/text_scale_step carried by WISettings across the title->world boundary.
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: Same assert_event_logged fix as the title-side open above -- this snapshot fires as part of open() itself, before ui_settings_shown.
== Reduce Motion toggle (KEYBOARD path): down x5 from 'Master volume' -> 'Reduce Motion' (index 5).
== Controls reference sub-page: down x1 -> 'Controls...' (index 6), Confirm opens it -- data-driven row count from WIInputHints.LABELS.kb.
== Replay Hints: down x1 from 'Controls...' -> 'Replay Hints' (index 7), Confirm fires the re-arm.
== Close settings (KEYBOARD path): down x1 -> 'Back' (index 8), Confirm closes -- the pause menu resumes right where it was (cursor untouched, no re-open).
== SAVE / LOAD round trip: pause_menu's own cursor is still on 'Settings' (index 7, the row that opened it) -- down x2 reaches 'Save' (index 1).
Save closed the pause menu -- reopen (fresh cursor 0) and down x2 reaches 'Load' (index 2).
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: == PERSISTENCE PROOF: the save/load round trip just tore down and rebuilt EVERY UI layer (including settings_panel.gd itself) via swap_to_world -- reduce_motion survives because WISettings is a config-file-backed autoload, never touched by Game.load_slot/WISave. Config-file idiom, NOT save data.
